caption:
The Sunday dread isn't about Monday. It's about the shift — from the version of you that rests to the version that performs. Your brain is grieving free time before it's even gone. The Sunday Page names it. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this for tonight.

#sundayscaries #overthinking #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
